profile.headline: Hi, I'm Rick.
profile.summary: I'm a product design leader. I help teams make tools that let people spend less time fighting fires and more time on the work they came to do.
profile.aboutSummary: I have over 13 years of experience across product design, systems thinking and implementation. I help teams turn complex workflows into products people can understand and teams can keep improving. My work includes finding the right structure, building reusable foundations and carrying design decisions into code. More recently, I’ve also worked on AI-assisted workflows, with attention to context, review and human judgment.

projects.title: Multi Product Integrations
projects.summary: I helped teams share patterns and workflows across separate products and applications.

previewMedia.alt: Overlapping service interfaces showing work-order records, service listings, inventory, and a map-based activity view.

projects.discovery: We identified core personas and mapped their workflows to find reusable domain experiences and support future journey and experience maps.
projects.outcomes: I designed a platform framework and worked with early adopters to build trust. The work enabled real-time operational data views and reduced administrative work and UX-operations rework.
